answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities by charging money per identity. An agent burns a 30-unit tax, never refunded, to register, and a quartz clock meters 3 units per epoch to keep its lantern lit; only lit lanterns get work. A willow marks the rule: one tree, one tax, or it withers. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 units plus 3,000 per epoch, far above the reward they could split. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
